name: Spatial transcriptomics clustering, alignment and integration benchmark
description: Evaluates clustering, alignment, and integration methods for spatial transcriptomics across datasets and metrics to assess method performance for multiple tasks.
evaluation_method: task-specific quantitative metrics (Adjusted Rand Index (ARI), Normalized Mutual Information (NMI), LISI, kBET, etc.)
general_score_metric: Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) for clustering (supplemented by NMI, LISI, kBET for integration/alignment)
typical_sota_score: dataset-dependent (ARI often ranges ~0.4–0.9 on published benchmarks); overall unknown
reputation: Well-regarded within the computational spatial biology community for method comparison, with moderate adoption.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; metrics and rankings are sensitive to preprocessing, annotation quality, and batch effects. Performance is highly dataset-dependent and some datasets are small or heterogeneous.
